children: was raised to Buy from Hold at Truist Securities on upside to consensus amid rising rates.

"We see mid-to-high single-digit upside to consensus as rising rates filter in. It is not a secret they are asset sensitive, but a) consensus is unchanged as the rate outlook has shifted; it's a small-cap stock, and analysts have just been slow to adjust; b) the stock is down over 10% from the July peak, so it is not like the share price has been front-running estimates; and c) on our refreshed numbers the stock is ~8.5x 2027 earnings, so it seems like an attractive entry point," said the research note.
"At $3B of market cap it is not for everyone, but that is part of the opportunity—at this size sometimes opportunity is hiding in plain sight," said analyst Brian Foran.
Price target was raised to $37.00 from $35.00. Shares were 0.48% higher at $31.70 during pre-market trading on Friday.
